text: A tall figure in a travel-stained cloak kneels beside you in the ashes. "Easy, little one. The bandits are gone."
"My name is Holloway. I keep the Heroes' Guild. There is nothing left for you here, but there could be something for you there."
"No! I have to find my family!"
His grip is warm and steady. He lifts you onto his horse without another word.
"If they live, you'll need to be strong enough to find them," he says gently, and lifts you up anyway.
